venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: Very quiet 4/20 Monday at Close Company ATL. Handful of folks for the first few hours; small pop at 10pm with a lined bar and one table. Last call was easy and everyone was out by 12:15am. Bar team used downtime to deep-clean the back bar, dri-deck mats, stainless steel behind the bar, and wash/stock new glassware.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: Steady from start to finish. A 30-person birthday party arrived around 9pm and stayed through close, driving volume well past target (+132% vs goal). Eli and Naya had good training shifts. Birthday party sang for the birthday girl at last call — nice moment.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: DC/AM $902.33, D&C PM $4,528.28, food $1,100.80. Chill Monday — plenty of practice rounds, prep work on fresh turmeric-ginger tea, miel, caramel, miso sesame. Deep-cleaned coffee urns; ABK'd shelves. Sleepy evening led to early cuts; MOD ran the floor from 10pm for final 3 tables. Beat target by ~29%.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: Solo-server 'hummingbird' night. 123 covers, 66 oysters, 1 large party, 6 solos, no investor cocktails. Top sellers: Masari, Root & Rye, Revenant. Thomas ran the door through reservations early; 9-11pm was peak. 1 coupe chipped. Missed target by just 1.3%.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: Slow burn start, bar picked up at 9pm, full house by 10 with walk-in 3s and 4s. Everyone buttoning up by 11. Lots of industry visits — Camphor, Yunomi, Griffin. Doubled food sales goal. Beat target by ~8% ($3,123 vs $2,892). Low on Macallan 12.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: No EON report submitted for 4/20. Last DC EON posted to #dc_eon_report was for 4/18 service (posted 4/19 02:04 EDT). Likely submission delay — check with Cory/Kevin/Josh.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: Very quiet day overall — morning peaked at 3 tables; noon-3pm cocktail tasting with the team went well (Skylar training, Tia held the floor). Evening peak was a 20-cover 7pm reservation; cut accordingly. 9pm 10-top didn't land until 9:45. Missed target by ~40%. Morning MB $989, Evening MB $2,415, Sun Club $298, Hot Eye $0.
